contract: The selected MPEG-TS program driven through each source polling form. Each feed callback requests ordinary source delivery. The candidate reads the active program after every accepted PMT.

The candidate folds each validated PES in publication order. It places raw 33-bit time in period zero and preserves DTS absence. The source carrier start is derived from the first header range and the supplied packet size. Validated PES projects zero duration and flags and its original stream ID.
Trace identifies accepted program entries, raw headers, payload spans and source diagnostics. The reference exposes the packet fold, including its demux clock and flags.

The pinned formats worker opens the selected program with public MPEG-TS AVIO, NOPARSE and NOFILLIN, without stream discovery. It delivers ordinary entities in one AVIO source and flushes at a declared discontinuity.

The packet fold is the mpegts-pes fold: stream index, PID, PTS and DTS in 90 kHz ticks (INT64_MIN for absence), duration, position, flags, size, bytes and every side-data element. Input loading is outside the run. Both sides drain the last entity to logical end.
Every operation in the mpegts-pes corpus runs for each form, retaining its 272 request mappings and the hash of every ordered input.
Candidate header and payload source ranges are checked against the preloaded entity bytes. Partial progress and the public header flags are traced.
